Demetrius_Bacon_and_Eggsrecipe.text: Hello, @! ^^ Thank you for your previous help with my scientific research. This is a recipe given to me by a mysterious gentleman who calls himself a scientist. Now I am giving it to you, I hope you will like it! ^^-Demetrius

Linus_Kabobsrecipe.text: @! ^^ How have you been lately? I'm sending you my favorite barbecue recipe. ^^-Linus

Krobus_Mandrakegift.text: @! ^^ This is my first time trying to write a letter myself. This is a gift I'm giving you, a very precious herb. I hope you like it~ ^^-Krobus
Krobus_Mandrakegift.name: Krobus's Mandrake Gift
Dwarf_Mandrakegift.text: @! ^^ I dug up this great treasure while digging cave carrots yesterday, and my ears were almost deafened by him, but he died after I brought him into the sunlight. ^^ This is a very rare mandrake. I give it to you as a gift from a friend. It contains magic power, and if you process it finely and make it into a stew, drinking it can make your body strong. But remember, never eat it raw, it must be processed finely, otherwise its powerful magic will make you fall into a long sleep. ^^-Dwarf
Dwarf_Mandrakegift.name: Dwarf's Mandrake Gift
Wizard_Mandrakegift.text: @! ^^ After getting along for a while, I think you are strong enough and it's time for you to get in touch with some advanced materials. As for what you can do with it, you can try it yourself. ^^-M. Rasmodius, Wizard
Wizard_Mandrakegift.name: M. Rasmodius's Mandrake Gift
Vincent_Mandrakegift.text: Mr.@! ^^ I found this somewhat scary doll onion while picking onions south of my house yesterday. I couldn't put it back after accidentally pulling it out, and it followed me all the time. My mother and brother didn't sleep well last night. In the morning, the doll onion seemed to fall asleep. My mother thought he was noisy and didn't let me keep him. Can you help me take care of the doll onion? ^^-Vincent¦Ms.@! ^^ I found this somewhat scary doll onion while picking onions south of my house yesterday. I couldn't put it back after accidentally pulling it out, and it followed me all the time. My mother and brother didn't sleep well last night. In the morning, the doll onion seemed to fall asleep. My mother thought he was noisy and didn't let me keep him. Can you help me take care of the doll onion? ^^-Vincent
Vincent_Mandrakegift.name: Vincent's Mandrake Gift
Gil_Mandrakegift.text: Brave adventurer @! ^^ I have seen your abilities, take what I give you and continue to break through your limits. ^^-Gil
Gil_Mandrakegift.name: Gil's Mandrake Gift
Harvey_Mandrakegift.text: Oh my God, @! ^^ I heard that you recently went to the very dangerous Skeleton Cave, and I am very worried about your personal safety. This is the ancestral anesthetic left by my grandfather, and I will give you a little to be prepared for any need. Promise me, pay attention to safety, okay? ^^-Harvey
Harvey_Mandrakegift.name: Harvey's Mandrake Gift
Joja_Powdercakerecipe.text: Dear customer @! ^^ This is our company's new product, and now we are offering a trial taste to all loyal Joja customers. We will randomly select 10 lucky ones to receive the confidential recipe of the new product. If you are satisfied, please give us a five-star review for our service. Thank you for your support! You are the fourth lucky one, and the attachment contains your reward, please keep it properly! According to Article 34 of our company's new product research confidentiality agreement, users are prohibited from disseminating this recipe in any commercial form, and violators will pay our company a penalty of 10 million. ^^-Joja New Product Marketing Department
Joja_Powdercakerecipe.name: Joja's Cheesecake Recipe
Evelyn_Pumpkin_Cookiesrecipe.text: I usually don't pass on my own recipes... but you have always been considerate to me and George, this is the recipe I wrote especially for you. ^^-Evelyn

Evelyn_Taffyrecipe.text: Thank you for your care for me and George over these times, this recipe is our family treasure, and now I give it to you, wishing you a happy life! ^^-Evelyn

Joja_Lobster_Dinnerrecipe.text: Dear customer @! ^^ You are now a major taxpayer in Pelican Town. To highlight your noble status, our company is giving you the recipe of the signature dish from Zuzhu City's five-star restaurant. ^ We sincerely hope that you can cooperate with us. If you are willing to sell this farm to us, our staff will take care of your farm and pay you 100,000 gold coins. After that, you can get 1% of the farm's revenue every month for 30 years. For detailed contract content, please go to our company to understand. We sincerely invite you to join our Joja company. ^^-Joja Group Board of Directors
